Eames inside your room

Original chair and ottoman inside finalscene.glb. No added studio walls or ceiling panel. External daylight is supplied because the room has no authored lights.

Experimental adaptive sampling: known lighting artifacts remain. Six bounces, 32/16/8/4/2/1 SPP rings (5.95 average), denoise off. Not real-time or quality-qualified.

Placement moves the chair and ottoman together. Changes apply on Render; wall collisions are not checked.

Splitting requires the stable sampler. It adds secondary rays, not camera SPP. No split after the selected depth.

Benchmark uses the stable sampler for every variant: one warmup, three rotated timing rounds, then diagnostic images. Keep this tab visible; it may take several minutes.
